tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Everything sits on it unless it has a reason not to.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, code, the query editor, hovered rows. Recedes from ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Overlays only: menus, popovers, dialogs. Always with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate regions and rows. Decorative: carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: rule-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on ground, sunken and raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and data on ground, sunken and raised.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on ground, sunken and raised: descriptions, legends, axis labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata and placeholders on ground, sunken and raised. The lightest text that still passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Deliberately below contrast; never for content.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The primary action: one per view. Also the selected state of a control. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a blue button.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue and blue-hover.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, and the critical status mark. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a red button.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red and red-hover.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Affirming actions (resolve, acknowledge), and the healthy status mark.

tokens.name: green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a green button.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on green and green-hover.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Cautionary actions (silence, snooze), and the warning status mark. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: yellow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a yellow button.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on yellow and yellow-hover.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (blue). Series colours are assigned in this fixed order and belong to the entity, not its rank.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (orange).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (aqua). Below 3:1 on a light ground: needs a direct label or the table view.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (yellow). Below 3:1 on a light ground: needs a direct label or the table view.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (magenta). Below 3:1 on a light ground: needs a direct label or the table view.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (green).

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Chart series 7 (violet).

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Chart series 8 (red). A ninth series folds into Other.

families.serif: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", Charter, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif
families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the name of the thing being looked at.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Requests that took longer than 500 ms, by route.
styles.usage: Prose: descriptions, reports, documentation. Measure 60 to 72 characters.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The default for interface text: controls, menus, panel titles, table cells with words.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, selected items, panel titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column heads and field labels, set in true small caps, so their height matches the lowercase of ui text beside them. The only tracked style.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every number a person compares, and every identifier they copy: values, timestamps, trace ids.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: The one value in a row that answers the question.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Optical nudges only: icon to label baseline, gap between stacked chart fills.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a control: icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the page gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels; the page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a page title; around an empty state.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, panels, anything that tiles edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Marks inside a control: checkboxes, status squares, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, fields, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Overlays: menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The only shadow. On raised surfaces, to say that something floats above the page.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of controls inside dense toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Table row and menu item height.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Every icon. One size.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running prose.
